fields.description: Canonical/normalized number used to group messages into this conversation (Brazilian mobile numbers' ambiguous 9th digit stripped — see takion_whatsapp.utils.normalize_phone_number). Internal matching key only — not shown to agents, use phone_number_display for that, and wa_id for sending.
fields.label: Phone Number

fields.description: Human-facing number, always with the Brazilian 9th digit reinserted (every real BR mobile number has it — see takion_whatsapp.utils.format_phone_number_display). Derived from phone_number at creation, shown in the conversation list/thread.
fields.label: Phone

fields.description: Raw wa_id as last reported by Meta on an inbound message from this contact — used verbatim as the "to" when sending replies, since it's the form Meta itself most recently confirmed as deliverable.
fields.label: WhatsApp ID (send-to)

fields.description: Reuses Frappe's native Contact doctype (no new entity) — resolved by phone number, auto-created (phone number only) if no match exists.
fields.label: Contact
